meta.title: DeepSeek Chat
meta.description: Adds a native DeepSeek Chat mode beside Agent mode, with a shared Chat | Agent switch. It supports deep thinking with Off/Low/High/Max effort, web search with citations, URL reading, file and image upload, model selection, persistent history, folders, pin/archive, history search, message editing, answer versions, and Chat to Agent handoff. Chat uses the signed-in DeepSeek account or a DeepSeek API key stored in the DSH credential store; the key never reaches the browser. Web search and document parsing use DeepSeek services and may incur usage charges. Agent mode and existing DSH capabilities are unchanged.
